requirement: Mandatory Penalty for IRI Category A

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: The Contractor shall be subject to a mandatory penalty of $2500 for each 10 metre segment with an IRI > 3.00 mm/m, with the exception of areas defined in 261.4.5.7.2.7.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: The Owner reserves the right to require compulsory corrective Work on any of the sections with an IRI > 3.00 mm/m. In sections where compulsory corrective Work is required, the Owner shall waive the $2500 penalty.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: The Owner shall notify the Contractor if compulsory corrective Work is required.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: Compulsory Corrective Work Procedures

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: Corrective work shall consist of removal and replacement of the surface course of asphalt concrete. The minimum length of any repair area shall be 10 metres.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: On each of the 10 metre segments affected, the Contractor shall remove (by cold milling) and replace the full width of the driving lane and the full depth of the surface course.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: The asphalt concrete repair shall conform to 261.4.5.11.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: Retesting Following Corrective Work

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: After corrective work has been completed, each of the 100 metre segments containing corrective work shall be retested, using the same profiler used in the original testing. The new IRI values shall be used and recalculated results shall be binding.

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: Cost for Corrective Work

source: NBDTI Standard Specifications for Highway Construction 2023 — Item 261 (End Result Specification / ERS)
requirement: All costs associated with corrective work, including retesting, shall be the responsibility of the Contractor.
